Made with galvanised or colourbond systems, the carports suit cars, boats, caravans, motorbikes and jet skis, and are customisable with installation by the company's builders. Variants include the Flat/Skillion, Raised Flyover and Gable designs. The company serves Brisbane and the Sunshine Coast, with products backed by 15-year warranties.

The passage describes techniques for time-aware networks (TANs) and time-sensitive applications (TSAs), including low-latency, scalable gate control for time-sensitive networking (TSN), enabling multiple TSAs to share one physical network link, and time-aware energy-efficient communication. It covers background on IoT/Industry 4.0 timing needs, PTP/gPTP synchronization (gPTP domains, PTP end and relay instances, grandmaster selection via BMCA, PTP and ARB timescales), and the PTP instance model. It details transmission selection based on traffic classes and queues, and IEEE 802.1Qbv scheduled traffic, where per-queue gates are controlled by a gate control list (GCL) containing operations such as SetGateStates. Existing TSN NICs store the GCL in on-chip SRAM (e.g., 4 KB), causing large silicon area, high power consumption (250 MHz clocking), and slow programming (over 1 ms) unsuitable for short cycle times. A proposed NIC architecture moves the GCL to host memory, using a small prefetch buffer, a dedicated (R)DMA channel, bank ownership bits, and odd/even bank ping-ponging to enable sub-nanosecond resolution, reduced area and power, and in-cycle programming. Finally, it describes configuring complex end stations hosting multiple talker applications—presented during discovery as a virtual switch with virtual end stations—using SRP protocols (MMRP, MVRP, MSRP) and a TSN configuration service with a gate control engine.

Mark Mobius warned that a 30 percent correction in US markets is not unforeseen, citing massive ETF outflows and algorithmic trading that could create a snowball effect with no safety valve. He noted emerging markets are vulnerable to contagion from Turkey's deteriorating situation, though selective opportunities exist. Economist Paul Krugman also warned of a possible 1997-8 style self-reinforcing emerging market currency crisis.
The passage describes eight drawings of a desk lamp design from various views; dashed lines mark unclaimed portions.

IUP President Michael Driscoll halted the Academic Integrity Board's investigation and allowed Lake Ingle to return to class. Ingle, cited for violating the code after speaking in a religious studies discussion on transgender issues, claimed his free speech rights were violated. A First Amendment expert will monitor the class.

The passage is a guide to trading options in TQQQ, an ETF that tracks the Nasdaq-100 index. It distinguishes option trading from stock trading: options involve buying and selling calls and puts—the rights to buy or sell a security at a set price—while stock trading involves buying and selling shares. TQQQ options come in European style (exercisable only at expiration) and American style (exercisable any time before expiration), with various expiration dates and strike prices.

Common strategies include buying calls, buying puts, writing covered calls, and writing puts, each with advantages and disadvantages; the best strategy depends on the investor's goals, risk tolerance, and trading style. The article stresses using a risk-managed approach, selecting liquid options, and backtesting ideas before committing money.

Because options are leveraged products, trading them in TQQQ carries high risk, with potential for greater returns but also greater losses; it is described as speculative and unsuitable for everyone. Recommended precautions include stop loss orders, cautious use of leverage, diversification, and never investing more than one can afford to lose.

Additional points: minimum capital requirements vary by broker; entry and exit timing depend on goals and risk tolerance; profits are generally subject to capital gains tax; costs include broker commissions, contract fees, and slippage; performance can be analyzed through fundamental and technical analysis; fair value can be estimated with the Black-Scholes model; and regulations cover minimum capital, leverage limits, margin calls, stop loss orders, and hedging. Benefits include higher potential returns, leverage, hedging, risk reduction, and the ability to trade short-term market movements.

The passage is an inaugural address delivered after the speaker took the oath of office, with Vice President Kamala Harris—the first woman elected to national office in American history—also sworn in. The speaker celebrates the triumph of democracy and the peaceful transfer of power on ground where violence occurred just days earlier. The address identifies major challenges facing the nation: a once-in-a-century virus that has taken as many lives in one year as World War II, lost jobs and closed businesses, a 400-year cry for racial justice, a planet in crisis, and rising political extremism, white supremacy, and domestic terrorism. The central theme is unity, described as the path forward, with the speaker invoking Lincoln's Emancipation Proclamation and pledging to bring Americans together to combat anger, hatred, extremism, disease, and hopelessness. The speaker pledges to be a president for all Americans, urges an end to an "uncivil war" between political factions, and stresses a duty to defend truth against lies told for power and profit. Addressing those beyond America's borders, the speaker promises to repair alliances and lead by the power of example. The address includes a moment of silent prayer for the 400,000 Americans lost to the pandemic and closes with a pledge to level with the American people and defend the Constitution and democracy, framing the future as an American story of hope, unity, and healing rather than fear and division.

University at Albany chemists synthesized manganese diboride (MnB2), a boron-rich compound that is over 20% more energetic by weight and about 150% more energetic by volume than the aluminum used in solid rocket boosters. The compound is stable until ignited by an agent such as kerosene. It was produced by pressing manganese and boron powders into a pellet, heating it to 3,000°C with an arc melter, and rapidly cooling it, creating a strained, crowded atomic structure. Computer models revealed skewed hexagonal lattices, called "deformation," which store the compound's high potential energy. Beyond rocket fuel, related boron-based research shows potential for more durable catalytic converters and breaking down plastics.

The new European football season has begun with disciplinary problems. Cristiano Ronaldo received a five-match domestic ban after pushing a referee during Real Madrid's Spanish Super Cup win over Barcelona, having also been booked for diving and for removing his jersey in celebration. Cesc Fabregas was sent off as Chelsea lost its Premier League opener to Burnley, following captain Gary Cahill's dismissal. Newcastle's Jonjo Shelvey was sent off in a 2-0 loss to Tottenham, and Lille goalkeeper Mike Maignan was dismissed in a 3-0 defeat to Strasbourg. Juventus' Miralem Pjanic escaped with a yellow card for kicking Lazio's Ciro Immobile. Off the pitch, transfer disputes involve Virgil van Dijk, Philippe Coutinho, Neymar's sale to Paris Saint-Germain, Danny Rose's criticized interview, and Diego Costa. UEFA is launching a respect campaign later this month.

Barry "The Hatchet" Vagnoni, a Reading, Pennsylvania, man who has been a Philadelphia Eagles fan since 1954, hosts large game-day gatherings in a 2,000-square-foot "locker room" man cave he built 13 years ago after being inspired by the movie "Field of Dreams." The space, featuring a 35-foot bar, 16 televisions, and extensive Eagles memorabilia, typically hosts 125 to 175 guests who must wear Eagles gear and follow family-friendly rules. For Super Bowl LII, when the Eagles face the New England Patriots in Minneapolis, he and his wife Dawn of 56 years expect more than 100 people, along with a band, dancers, and 50 pounds of wings. Food and drinks are free. Vagnoni, who will think of his late father during the game, says he would choose an Eagles Super Bowl victory over winning the Powerball.

A research review of 10 trials involving 77,917 high-risk participants found omega-3 fatty acid supplements did not reduce cardiovascular disease risk. Participants, averaging 64 years old, were randomly assigned to supplements or placebo for at least one year and followed for an average of 4.4 years. Rates of heart disease death, heart attacks, strokes, and artery-reopening procedures were similar regardless of supplement use. The senior study author said the results do not support American Heart Association guidelines recommending omega-3 supplements for patients with prior coronary heart disease. Limitations included varied trial designs and missing data on smoking and cancer history. Other experts noted the supplements are inexpensive, safe, and may offer other health benefits.

A gap is a price level not traded between one day's close and the next day's open. Gaps can occur in any time frame but are most frequent on daily charts, with overnight gaps being the most common. Most overnight gaps are "common gaps" with little significance; other types include exhaustion gaps (after extended moves), runaway gaps (sharp moves from consolidation), and breakaway gaps. Gap trading strategies have been popular for decades, but their profitability has diminished as computer power and the number of traders have grown. Gaps can be faded or followed, and stocks tend to be better suited to fading gaps than other asset classes. Backtests of 25 years of S&P 500 E-mini futures data showed smaller gaps fill more often: 0.1% gaps filled 59–61% of the time, 0.5% gaps filled 42–43%, and 1% gaps filled only 28–33%, with bearish gaps slightly easier to fill due to the market's upward bias. Example day trading strategies tested on 5-minute futures data from 2011 to July 2021 were not profitable, and shorting gaps performed even worse. A swing trading strategy holding the S&P overnight produced an average gain of 0.48% per trade with a profit factor of 1.8. Reliable data is essential for backtesting; free sources like Yahoo! Finance should only be trusted for opening and closing prices. Competition in stock indices is enormous and the easiest opportunities have been arbitraged away, though opportunities may exist in other markets.

Boscov's department store in downtown Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania, had a record-breaking sales year in 2017 while other stores like Bon-Ton and Sears closed. Customers credit its personal touch and hometown atmosphere, and loyal clientele drove a single-digit increase in physical store sales. Officials say the store supports other downtown businesses. Boscov's plans to open a 47th store in Connecticut.

The passage argues that schools require comprehensive renewal because society changes rapidly, though education must also maintain a critical time lag to reflect on whether changes are beneficial. It focuses on the transition from Millennials to Generation Z and Generation Alpha, collectively termed the Net generation, whose distinct learning characteristics—alongside new technological possibilities—necessitate a shift from digital to generative pedagogy. Key shifts include the existence of two intertwined worlds (physical and cyber), intelligence extending beyond biological forms to artificial intelligence, learning environments evolving from Internet 1.0 to 4.0, and education moving toward blended and non-formal models. Drawing on Schumpeter's "creative destruction," the text outlines waves of technological change from the steam engine through the sixth wave of generative AI, marked by OpenAI's founding (2015) and transformer architecture (2017). Pedagogical academia's response to AI followed the Kübler-Ross grief cycle, from denial to acceptance. The passage concludes that generative AI raises unresolved questions about knowledge, teaching, and assessment; the teacher will become a partner with GAI rather than sole authority, focusing on relationships and values in Bloom's affective domain.

Horses4Heroes, a Las Vegas-based non-profit operating an equestrian center at Floyd Lamb at Tule Springs, has opened registration for its Saturdays at the Ranch Day Camps (through May 19), Spring Break Camp (March 26-30), and 10 weeks of Summer Camp (beginning May 29) for children ages 5 to 13. Camps include horseback riding, farm animal interaction, and outings, with reduced rates for veterans, military personnel, law enforcement officers, teachers, and nurses. Teen volunteers ages 14-17 are welcome. The center also offers riding lessons, test rides, birthday parties, and free workshops for veterans and others in need. Proceeds support animal care and scholarships.

Smart beta ETF strategies have attracted hundreds of billions in assets, but many advisors remain unfamiliar with them. A 2018 FTSE Russell survey of 256 advisors found 79% of U.S. advisors were aware of smart beta, only 35% very familiar, and 47% cited insufficient knowledge as a barrier.

Bayard received an "unmodified" audit grade from Fierro & Fierro accountants, indicating its finances are in good shape, despite two minimal findings: a $700 deficit in a new fund created after the city received over $750,000 in federal Community Development Block Grants, and $64 in mileage miscalculations by city employees. The Bayard City Council also unanimously approved a resolution supporting the village of Santa Clara's efforts to secure management of Fort Bayard from the state. Santa Clara representative Scott Terry said the village seeks support, not money, and described a plan including renting office space to the U.S. Forest Service. Councilor Zeke Santa Maria expressed doubts about Santa Clara's capacity to manage the property, suggesting the county would do better. Mayor Pro Tem Chon Fierro also updated the council on plans to restore the Bayard train depot's exterior, noting the railroad owns the ground beneath the city-owned building.

Ric Flair, the 68-year-old pro wrestling legend, has been hospitalized and is dealing with "tough medical issues," according to his representative. Fellow wrestlers Mick Foley and Eric Bischoff wished him well on Twitter.

The passage is a Motley Fool Money review of the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card by personal finance writer Ryan Wilcox. The card targets people seeking to pay down debt or finance large purchases, offering 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (16.99%, 23.49%, or 28.74% variable APR thereafter). It charges no annual fee and includes cell phone protection of up to $600 against theft or damage, subject to a $25 deductible and usable twice per year. Drawbacks include a 5% balance transfer fee (minimum $5), a 3% foreign transaction fee, and no ongoing rewards after the intro period. The recommended credit score is Good/Excellent (670-850), and the card was named Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2025. The page also contains advertiser compensation disclosures and brief mentions of comparison cards from Discover and Bank of America.

Xu Yan, wife of detained Chinese human rights lawyer Yu Wensheng, said police prevented her from leaving her neighborhood. Yu was detained Jan. 19 and charged with inciting subversion, extending a crackdown on legal activists launched in July 2015. German Chancellor Angela Merkel met privately with Xu and the wife of another detained lawyer.

The President vetoes House bill No. 1471, which would double Andrew J. Hill's pension, his claim for an increase having been rejected by the Pension Bureau on the ground that his current pension is commensurate with his disability. He questions the policy of Congress frequently reversing Bureau decisions by special legislation, arguing such action should be rare and exceptional, lest claims that could not survive Bureau examination succeed through misplaced sympathy and discredit the system. Of nearly 240 special pension bills presented to him the same day, 81 of the 232 classified were approved despite insufficient testimony, while others covered claims rejected on various grounds or never presented to the Bureau, involving over $35,000 annually; unable to examine them fully in the time allowed, he let them become law without approval. The bill also names Andrew J. Hill, though records and a medical certificate show the intended beneficiary is Alfred J. Hill.

The Xiaomi Mi 8 features a Snapdragon 845 chipset, 6GB RAM, a 6.21-inch AMOLED screen, dual-frequency GPS, and dual-12MP cameras. The budget Mi 8 SE, the first with Snapdragon 710, has a 3,120 mAh battery and starts at 1,799 yuan ($280).

The Mid Screen, the most used offensive tactic, involves a "Big" screening for a "Little" and can result in dribble penetration if the on-ball defender is hung up on the screen. Two defensive strategies are described. The Basic NBA Show & Recover is preferred in the NBA because switching would allow the screener to post up against a smaller defender. Its phases are: Show (X1 pushes the ballhandler to the sideline while X5 steps out hard), Recover (X5 sprints back to the post once X1 re-establishes position), and Final Match Up (defenders assume denial, on-ball, and weakside help positions). The All Out SOS Disruption traps the point guard before any screen or pass occurs, forcing the offense into freelance mode. Its phases include the double team trap, rotations on the pass out of the trap, and a final alignment applying SOS defensive principles.

ChatGPT is an AI developed by OpenAI, based on the GPT architecture, that can assist traders by performing sentiment analysis on financial news and social media, coding technical indicators and trading strategies, and generating predictions from historical market data. However, it cannot identify the most profitable strategies on its own; traders must backtest generated strategies to verify profitability before deploying them in live markets. The article notes that ChatGPT can be incorrect and overly confident when wrong, and that artificial intelligence remains in its infancy compared to human experience and intuition in trading. In a test, the authors asked ChatGPT to create a mean reversion strategy for Amibroker; while it produced logical trading rules and code quickly, the resulting code contained numerous errors. The authors conclude that ChatGPT is useful for providing hints but cannot be expected to deliver correct results, and it functions only as a tool for creating strategies rather than an automated trading system itself.

The paper introduces Cell2Text, a multimodal generative framework that converts single-cell RNA-seq profiles into natural-language descriptions covering cell type, tissue, disease, developmental stage, and pathway activity. The method combines a frozen Geneformer encoder producing gene-level (rather than pooled) embeddings, a lightweight two-layer adapter that projects these embeddings into the language model's semantic space, and an instruction-tuned LLM decoder (Meta-Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct or Gemma3-4B-it), trained via full fine-tuning or LoRA. A dataset of 1 million cells from CELLxGENE, spanning 783 cell types, 347 tissues, and 128 diseases, was constructed with ontology, tissue, disease, and pathway annotations, using donor-level 80/10/10 splitting. Experiments show high semantic fidelity (BioBERT F1 above 93.9 for fully tuned models) and that Cell2Text outperforms Geneformer+Head and LGBM baselines on cell type, tissue, and disease classification, with Cell2Text-Gemma-4B reaching 77.83% cell type and 73.04% tissue accuracy. A PageRank-based Cell Ontology similarity metric indicates predictions are ontologically coherent, with fully tuned models achieving up to 85.62% similarity. On pathway classification, Cell2Text is competitive and surpasses Geneformer+Head, though LGBM performs better on ranking-based metrics. The authors conclude that training for text generation yields richer cellular representations than classification heads and propose combining domain-specific pretrained models with LLMs as a general strategy for computational biology.

The NES Classic Mini, originally priced at $60, has been resold at higher prices on eBay. A NeoGAF user claiming to be a Nordic retailer employee said Nintendo confirmed production has ended, with final shipments expected by April or May. It remains unconfirmed whether this applies worldwide, despite Nintendo's earlier promise to increase production.

The volume documents Shultz's bureaucratic struggles with the NSC over implementing NSDD 75's four-part agenda and gaining access to Reagan, resolved by a June 1983 understanding with Clark granting weekly meetings. With NSC adviser Jack Matlock as an ally, Shultz pressed for continued dialogue with the Soviets despite opposition from officials like Weinberger. The volume covers 1983 flashpoints—including SDI's announcement, the KAL 007 downing, the Euromissiles crisis, the Soviet "War Scare," and Able Archer—during which Shultz maintained engagement. After the Soviet INF walkout, 1984 focused on restarting arms control talks, with SDI a major contention. In January 1985, Shultz and Gromyko agreed to three-track Nuclear and Space Talks in Geneva, just before Chernenko's death brought a younger, more ambitious Soviet leader. The volume concludes with editor acknowledgments.

This passage is a weekly job announcement email sent to Haas School of Business alumni on November 9, 2000. It lists 20 job openings from various companies seeking Haas alumni, including positions such as CEO (Dallas), SVP/General Manager (Austin), Chief Information Officer (Chicago), and roles at companies like Applied Materials, AXA Rosenberg, NetCurrents, SmartForce, McGraw Hill, Hewlett Packard, Wedbush Morgan Securities, Aetna US Healthcare, and Extensity. Many positions prefer or require an MBA. Expanded descriptions are provided for several postings, detailing responsibilities, qualifications, and application instructions. The email also announces a Women in Leadership Conference on November 11, 2000, and a Big Game Bar-B-Que on November 18, 2000. It includes instructions for submitting job openings, subscribing or unsubscribing to the list, and notes that listed companies have not been researched by the Haas School. The communication is supported in part by the Haas School Annual Fund.

This study investigated whether oxytocin (OT) enhances responses to social touch targeting CT-fibers (gentle stroking) versus non-CT fiber mechanoreceptors (medium pressure massage), and whether intranasal and oral (lingual) OT (24 IU) produce similar effects, which would suggest peripheral mediation. Using a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled between-subject design, 171 healthy Chinese participants received intranasal OT (N=56), oral OT (N=57), or placebo (N=58). Gentle stroking (5 cm/s) and medium pressure massage were applied to the calves, with fNIRS recording of oxy-Hb changes in orbitofrontal, pSTS, and somatosensory regions, alongside SCR, ECG, and blood sampling. Both OT routes increased plasma OT versus placebo (intranasal > oral) and selectively increased pleasantness ratings and neural responses in bilateral mOFC, mlOFC, and pSTS for gentle stroking touch only, with no effects for massage, lOFC, or S1, and no effects on arousal, intensity, willingness to pay, HRV, or SCR. OT prolonged the neural response to stroking. Time-course classification distinguished OT from placebo (~64–70% accuracy) but not intranasal from oral OT (51.3%). Post-treatment plasma OT increases correlated with, and fully mediated, enhanced pleasantness. The authors conclude that exogenous OT selectively facilitates CT-fiber-mediated touch processing via peripherally-mediated routes, with potential therapeutic implications for conditions such as autism. Limitations include fNIRS's restriction to superficial cortex, the artificial touch setting, unmeasured massage pressure, and limited blood sampling frequency.

The President reports abundant harvests, flourishing commerce, revenue exceeding expectations, and peace with foreign nations. A negotiation has opened in London with Great Britain covering commerce and other unsettled differences, with the existing convention extended for at least eight years. Relations with Spain remain largely unchanged; the 1802 convention has been ratified, but claims and boundaries remain unsettled. Spanish authority in the Floridas is nearly extinct, enabling adventurers, fugitives, and Indian tribes to violate US laws and incite the Seminole war. After adventurers seized Amelia Island, the United States suppressed the establishment and pursued the Seminoles; Major-General Jackson entered Florida and took St. Marks and Pensacola, which were subsequently ordered returned to Spain. Documents, including courts-martial proceedings for Arbuthnot and Ambristie, will be laid before Congress. The civil war between Spain and the South American Provinces continues, with several provinces declaring independence; the allied powers are expected to mediate without applying force. Treasury receipts exceeded $17M, customs revenue is estimated at $26M, and land sales surpassed prior years. Defense measures, Indian treaties yielding extensive cessions, new frontier posts, naval augmentation, Illinois's admission as a State, and governance of the District are also addressed.
Super Robot Wars X was announced for PS4 and PS Vita, launching March 29, 2018 in Japan and April 26 in Southeast Asia with English subtitles, alongside a Premium Edition and early purchase bonuses.

A study published in Nature by an international research team led by The University of Texas at Austin finds that hundreds of built and proposed hydroelectric dams may significantly harm life in and around the Amazon by trapping nutrient-rich sediment and modifying the regional climate. Of 428 proposed dams in the Amazon basin, 140 are built or under construction. Researchers introduced the Dam Environmental Vulnerability Index (DEVI), a 0-to-100 scale, to quantify dam impacts, identifying the Marañon, Ucayali, and Madeira rivers as most vulnerable. The Madeira River already shows a 20 percent decrease in sediment concentration following construction of two dams. If all planned dams are built, their cumulative effect may alter sediment flowing into the Atlantic Ocean and hinder the regional climate.

This patent application, a continuation of U.S. application Ser. No. 16/384,106 filed April 15, 2019, describes a smart gateway platform for industrial Internet of Things applications that applies analytics to extract business value from industrial data. The platform stores model templates associated with industrial business objectives, each defining data inputs and relationships (correlations and causalities) relevant to a business objective, based on encoded domain expertise. A user selects a template via a hierarchical classification schema organized by industry, machine type, and business objective, then provides mapping data linking the template's generic data inputs to data tags on industrial devices. The platform customizes the template into a model, collects data values from the mapped tags, normalizes the data, adds modeling metadata reflecting the defined relationships, and sends the resulting structured data to an artificial intelligence analytics system. By limiting collected data to items relevant to the selected business objective and pre-defining correlations, the approach reduces storage requirements and enables faster derivation of insights compared to conventional big data analysis, which processes large volumes of unstructured data and can produce spurious correlations. The data modeling component contextualizes raw data, supports smart data types (State, Rate, Odometer, and Event tags), augments data with AI metadata fields, organizes data according to enterprise and asset hierarchies, and synchronizes related data. Structured data can be fed to analytic systems operating at device, system (edge or gateway), or enterprise/cloud levels, with analytics scalable between levels based on time-sensitivity. Analytic systems may generate recommendations, notifications, or control outputs directed to industrial devices.

The passage describes a divisional patent application concerning novel cationic lipids and lipid nanoparticle formulations for delivering nucleic acids. The invention provides lipid compounds of Formula (I) that can be combined with neutral lipids, steroids, and polymer-conjugated lipids to form lipid nanoparticles for intracellular delivery of therapeutic nucleic acids, including mRNA, antisense oligonucleotides, siRNA, and plasmids, both in vitro and in vivo. The background identifies two key challenges in nucleic acid therapeutics: susceptibility of free RNAs to nuclease digestion in plasma and limited ability to access the intracellular compartment. The disclosed lipid nanoparticles address these issues by protecting nucleic acids from degradation and facilitating cellular uptake, while providing improved tolerability and therapeutic index compared to previously described compositions. The passage details the chemical structures and substituent definitions for the cationic lipids, describes methods for preparing and modifying nucleic acids (including in vitro transcription, 5' capping, 3' polyadenylation, and nucleoside modifications to reduce immunostimulatory activity), and outlines pharmaceutical compositions with specified molar ratios of components. Applications include protein expression, gene silencing, miRNA inhibition, and co-delivery of different nucleic acids. The passage also defines relevant terminology, describes various stereoisomers and pharmaceutically acceptable salts, and provides methods for administering the compositions to patients for treatment of diseases or conditions.

This paper addresses inconsistent trajectory generation in mobile robot motion planning caused by uncertainty in successive environment maps. Deterministic planners like KEASL, when relying only on the most recent cost map, produce oscillating plans around inconsistently classified obstacles due to sensor noise, occlusions, and state estimation errors. The authors propose incorporating multiple temporally sampled world model hypotheses into edge cost computation, treating the most recent map as the primary hypothesis and prior maps as guides for the search. Four methods were developed: Valid in Every Hypothesis (VEH), which requires edges to be collision-free in all worlds but is overly conservative; Per-Edge Hypothesis (PEH), which reroutes edges per hypothesis but proved computationally impractical; Goal-Edge Hypothesis (GEH), which defers multi-hypothesis checking until goal expansion but concentrates expansions at the goal; and Goal-Edge Graph Revision Hypothesis (GEGRH), which adds a graph-revision step focusing expansions at divergence points. Experiments on 221 planning problems from UGV field data showed GEGRH reduced planning time by 15.4% (two hypotheses) and 29.27% (three hypotheses) and path duration by 6.64% and 18.72%, respectively, compared to VEH, though both were slower and more conservative than single-hypothesis planning. Future work includes incorporating more hypotheses, handling non-binary map divergence, alternative cost functions, and hypothesis certainty estimates.
Christopher Koziana, 29, of Essex, faces impaired driving charges after his vehicle struck a gas meter Tuesday. He was arrested at the scene and will appear in Windsor court June 13.

President Trump condemned white supremacists, neo-Nazis, and the KKK as "repugnant" in a White House statement Monday, after facing criticism from both parties for staying silent for nearly 48 hours following the Charlottesville attack that left one woman dead. An unnamed official had said Sunday that Trump condemned these groups. Trump also criticized Merck CEO Ken Frazier, who resigned from the president's manufacturing council over his failure to condemn white supremacists.

Microsoft Corporation's Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended December 31, 2019 reports second-quarter fiscal 2020 revenue of $36.9 billion, up 14% from $32.5 billion a year earlier, and net income of $11.6 billion, up 38% from $8.4 billion, with diluted earnings per share of $1.51 versus $1.08. For the six months ended December 31, 2019, revenue was $70.0 billion and net income was $22.3 billion. Results are reported across three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Commercial cloud revenue increased 39% to $12.5 billion, and Azure grew 62%. Total assets were $282.8 billion as of December 31, 2019, with stockholders' equity of $110.1 billion. Long-term debt totaled $63.4 billion, with total face value of debt at $70.2 billion. The effective tax rate was 17% for the quarter, and unrecognized tax benefits and other income tax liabilities were $16.0 billion. Unearned revenue was $31.2 billion, and remaining performance obligations were $93 billion. Goodwill was $42.2 billion. Microsoft repurchased $4.6 billion of stock in the quarter under a $40 billion program approved in 2016, with $2.8 billion remaining; a new $40 billion program was approved in September 2019. Dividends of $0.51 per share were declared. As of December 31, 2019, 50 patent infringement cases were pending, accrued legal liabilities were $319 million, and reasonably possible adverse outcomes were estimated at approximately $900 million beyond recorded amounts. Deloitte & Touche LLP reviewed the interim financial statements.

The Yankees, eliminated from the 2025 playoffs by Toronto, face an eventful offseason. A prediction has them acquiring Steven Kwan as their 2026 leadoff hitter and Josh Naylor at first base, replacing Trent Grisham and Paul Goldschmidt, while most core pieces remain.

Matthew Lane, a 19-year-old college freshman from Sterling, Massachusetts, pleaded guilty in June to a ransomware attack on education technology company PowerSchool and is scheduled to be sentenced in federal court. Prosecutors say he worked with at least one unnamed co-conspirator to steal records of more than 60 million students and 10 million educators, extorting nearly $3 million from the company in what is widely considered the largest exposure of private student data in history. They are seeking a seven-year prison sentence and more than $14 million in restitution; Lane returned about $160,000, with roughly $3 million unaccounted for. According to prosecutors and a threat intelligence report from cybersecurity firm Cyble, Lane's cybercrime activity dates back to at least 2021, targeting at least eight victims including a school athletic association, private companies, and foreign governments. In September 2024, he allegedly used stolen credentials to hack PowerSchool and transfer files to a server in Ukraine, then demanded about $2.85 million in Bitcoin. The attack cost the company more than $14 million. Cyble tied online aliases including "g0re" to Lane and concluded he was a "seasoned cybercriminal" rather than a first-time offender. Neighbors and former classmates described Lane as a quiet, introverted gamer and skilled programmer.

A Gartner analyst argues Windows 10 Pro is a dead end for enterprises, predicting Microsoft will reduce its support and limit enterprise management features to push businesses toward Windows 10 Enterprise. Though Pro has long been the most popular pre-installed OS on business PCs, Microsoft's support changes have widened the gap: six-month support extensions for certain Windows 10 versions and the paid supplemental servicing option, which adds 12 months, apply only to Enterprise and Education editions. Pro users must still upgrade within 18 months. Kleynhans and Michael Silver recommend Pro customers monitor Microsoft's lifecycle announcements and budget for Enterprise, as Pro becomes more "pro-sumer" and small-business oriented.

Stock futures were little changed after the S&P 500 snapped a 7-day winning streak. Bridgewater Associates founder Ray Dalio recommended investors allocate up to 15% of their portfolios to gold, calling it an excellent diversifier and a hedge in times of monetary debasement and geopolitical uncertainty. Gold surged to an all-time high above $4,000 an ounce, with futures last trading at $4,005.80, up more than 50% this year amid mounting fiscal deficits and rising global tensions. Dalio compared today's environment to the early 1970s, when inflation, heavy government spending, and high debt eroded confidence in paper assets and fiat currencies. His recommendation contrasts with typical 60-40 stock-bond portfolio guidance. Another investor recommended a gold weighting as high as 25%, citing inflationary pressures and a weaker dollar.
John Howendobler is in jail after calling dispatch just before 1:30 a.m. Friday to report choking his wife, who told officers he woke suddenly and began choking her.

Veeco Instruments Inc. published a slide deck in conjunction with an M&A call regarding Axcelis Technologies, Inc. A chart displays time-based data from September 29 to October 3, 2025, with values ranging from 29.855 to 33.71.

Two years after South Sudan's independence, Dr. Inka Weissbecker found the country's only mental health facility in prison-like conditions, but donors refused funding, saying the country had bigger problems. Mental health disorders affect one in four people globally, more in strife-torn low- and middle-income countries, yet funding arrived only after civil war created visible trauma. Untreated mental illness contributes to cardiovascular disease, diabetes, obesity, and substance abuse, straining health systems. Low-income countries average one psychiatrist per two million people and spend under one percent of health budgets on mental health, often directing funds to disruptive, stigmatized institutions rather than outreach. The UN Sustainable Development Goals recognize mental health as a human right; the authors call for more psychiatrists, community-based services, and reduced stigma.

Apple Inc.'s Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended December 29, 2018 reports total net sales of $84,310 million, down 5% from $88,293 million in the prior-year quarter, driven primarily by a 15% decline in iPhone net sales to $51,982 million, partially offset by increases in Wearables, Home and Accessories (33%), Services (19%), iPad (17%) and Mac (9%). Net income was $19,965 million versus $20,065 million, with diluted earnings per share of $4.18 compared to $3.89. By segment, Americas net sales rose 5% to $36,940 million, while Greater China fell 27% to $13,169 million; Europe and Japan declined 3% and 5%, and Rest of Asia Pacific was roughly flat. Total gross margin was 38.0% versus 38.4%, and the effective tax rate was 16.5% versus 25.8%.

During the quarter, the Company adopted the new revenue standard (ASU 2014-09) using the full retrospective method with no material impact on prior periods, along with ASU 2016-01 and ASU 2016-16, the latter resulting in $2.7 billion of net deferred tax assets. As of December 29, 2018, total assets were $373,719 million; cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled $245,035 million in fair value, including $19.9 billion restricted; and debt consisted of $12.0 billion in commercial paper and $103.8 billion aggregate principal of term debt. Gross unrecognized tax benefits were $14.7 billion, and the €13.1 billion European Commission State Aid Decision recovery amount plus €1.2 billion interest remained in escrow pending appeals.

The Company repurchased $8.2 billion of common stock under a $100 billion repurchase authorization ($37.3 billion utilized) and paid $3.6 billion in dividends. Cash generated by operating activities was $26,690 million. Pending legal matters include VirnetX patent litigation, disputes with Qualcomm, and civil litigation and governmental inquiries regarding the iOS performance management feature.

Say it with Diamonds, a Liverpool Instagram jewellery business founded in 2016 by Charlotte Donoghue and Steph Porter, has opened its first store at Cavern Walks in the city centre. Starting with five necklaces on Instagram, the business grew to include celebrity clients such as Nicola Carragher and Georgia Toffolo. The founders aim to offer luxury jewellery at affordable prices and hope to become Liverpool's premier jewellery store.

President Trump announced a deal with AstraZeneca to offer discounted prescription drugs through TrumpRx, a federal website aimed at making drugs more affordable by eliminating intermediaries. AstraZeneca pledged $50 billion over five years for US drug research, development, and onshore manufacturing, and committed to offering Medicaid patients prices comparable to the lowest charged in other countries. Trump described the arrangement as a "most-favored-nation" drug pricing policy. The deal follows a similar September agreement with Pfizer, made in exchange for a three-year tariff exemption.

Shriram Transport Finance's shares fell nearly 12% amid concerns over group company SVL's ability to repay Rs 870 crore debentures, for which Shriram provided corporate guarantees in 2015. The company said SVL has sufficient resources to pay dues, with alternate mechanisms if needed.

This patent application, a divisional of U.S. application Ser. No. 15/220,371, describes methods and apparatus for manufacturing fiber-based containers and packaging as sustainable replacements for plastics. The background notes pollution from single-use plastics and reviews molded pulp history, including Type 1 ("dry") and Type 2 ("wet") vacuum forming processes.

The invention covers vacuum molded fiber products using novel slurries and coatings, including: produce containers with geometric features (rolled edges, skirts, ribs) for hoop strength; embedded or topical moisture, oil, and vapor barriers; modified vacuum tooling with re-directed spray nozzles to create larger vent holes; microwavable/oven-safe containers; meat containers with moisture barriers for extended shelf life; and beverage lids with moisture barriers.

The vacuum forming process uses a wire mesh-covered mold immersed in a fiber slurry, with a closed loop system that recirculates unused slurry and maintains steady-state chemistry via a sampling module. Slurry compositions include fiber bases (e.g., OCC/NP for produce containers; softwood/bagasse for microwavable, meat, and lid applications) with additives such as alkyl ketene dimer (AKD) moisture barriers, fluorocarbon oil barriers (e.g., UNIDYNE), starch or dry strength additives (e.g., Hercobond, Topcat), and wet strength additives (e.g., Kymene 577), with specified percentage ranges for each component.

For beverage lids with negative draft lock rings, a retractable piston tool—extended pneumatically—unlocks the finished lid from the mold. The application also describes utility and shipping containers, and claims methods for manufacturing produce containers, microwavable containers, meat trays, and lids, along with the resulting products and a flat screen TV shipping container kit.

Co-operative Group lost 132 million pounds in 2016 after writing off its 20 percent stake in the struggling Co-operative Bank, valuing it at nil. Despite this, operating profit rose 32 percent to 148 million pounds, driven by growth in supermarkets, funeral services, and insurance. Supermarket like-for-like sales grew 3.5 percent. The group is sourcing more British products amid rising food inflation following Brexit. Co-op has no role in the bank's sale, which has drawn bidders mostly interested in specific assets.

Microsoft Corporation's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2021 reports quarterly revenue of $41.7 billion (compared to $35.0 billion in the prior-year quarter) and net income of $15.5 billion (compared to $10.8 billion), with diluted earnings per share of $2.03. Nine-month revenue was $121.9 billion with net income of $44.8 billion. Total assets were $308.9 billion as of March 31, 2021.

On March 9, 2021, Microsoft completed its acquisition of ZeniMax Media Inc., parent company of Bethesda Softworks, for $8.1 billion, primarily in cash; ZeniMax is reported in the More Personal Computing segment. On April 11, 2021, Microsoft entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Nuance Communications for $19.7 billion in an all-cash transaction, expected to close by the end of calendar year 2021.

Microsoft reports three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Commercial cloud revenue increased 33% to $17.7 billion for the quarter. Azure grew 50%, and Xbox content and services revenue increased 34%.

A change in accounting estimates extended server equipment useful lives from three to four years and network equipment from two to four years, increasing quarterly operating income by $611 million. The effective tax rate was 10% for the quarter, reduced primarily by a $620 million benefit from an India Supreme Court ruling on withholding taxes.

As of March 31, 2021, total debt was $58.1 billion, unrecognized tax benefits and other income tax liabilities were $15.8 billion, and $14.9 billion remained under the September 2019 $40 billion share repurchase program. Quarterly dividends of $0.56 per share were declared. The COVID-19 pandemic continued to affect operations, benefiting cloud demand while transactional licensing remained weak.

Spartan Race Inc., founded in 2010 by Joe De Sena, became the world's most popular obstacle course race provider within seven years, raising $15 million through private equity investments in 2012 and 2016. In 2017, as De Sena considered an initial public offering, he questioned how the new revenue recognition accounting standard would affect Spartan's financial statements and scheduled a meeting with the company's Director of Financial Planning and Controller. The case describes the obstacle course racing industry, its slowing growth, Spartan's competitors, and the company's differentiation through timed, competition-focused races of varying lengths. It also covers Spartan's revenue diversification via partnerships with Reebok, NBC Sports, and Daily Burn, its ambition to see the sport in the Olympics, the five-step process of the new accounting standard, and Spartan's varied revenue streams, including race entries, annual passes, merchandise, sponsorships, training certifications, and international licensing.

After the Argentina GP, MotoGP heads to the Circuit of The Americas in Austin, Texas for the Red Bull Grand Prix of the Americas. Marc Marquez has won every COTA race since his first premier class victory there. In 2017, Maverick Viñales leads the championship after winning in Qatar and Argentina, where Marquez crashed while leading. Marquez aims to respond at his strongest track. Viñales leads with 50 points, ahead of Rossi (36) and Dovizioso (20).

The South Dakota Department of Agriculture urges producers suspecting dicamba-related crop damage to complete its online Dicamba Damage Survey, which will help evaluate the products' statewide impact. The ADS7828's SAR architecture is sensitive to glitches or sudden changes on the power supply, reference, ground, and digital inputs occurring just before the comparator output is latched; an n-bit conversion has n windows where external transients can affect results. Power should be clean and well-bypassed, with a 0.1µF ceramic capacitor placed close to the device and possibly a 1µF to 10µF capacitor if the supply connection impedance is high. The architecture provides no inherent rejection of noise on the external reference input, so supply noise and ripple appear directly in digital results, and line-frequency voltage variation is difficult to remove. The GND pin should connect to a clean ground point, typically analog ground, away from microcontroller or DSP grounding, ideally with a dedicated analog ground plane. The passage also includes footnotes on part status, material type, RoHS values, lead finish, MSL ratings, and part markings, along with TI disclaimers on information accuracy, liability limits, tape-and-reel dimension notes, and terms governing use of its technical resources.

This patent application describes methods and compositions for cancer detection using DNA methylation patterns in cell-free DNA (cfDNA). It provides bait sets (cancer assay panels) comprising oligonucleotide probes targeting genomic regions differentially methylated in cancer versus non-cancer samples. The methods involve converting unmethylated cytosines to uracil, enriching cfDNA via hybridization capture using these probes, sequencing enriched fragments, and applying classifiers to determine cancer presence, type, or stage. The application further describes methods for identifying differentially methylated genomic regions by comparing cfDNA fragments from cancer and non-cancer subjects, designing probe panels with minimal off-target binding, and training classification models using feature vectors derived from hypomethylated and hypermethylated fragment counts. Classifier performance metrics, including sensitivity at specified specificity levels across multiple cancer types, are provided.

Some embodiments provide a packet processing pipeline that enhances match-action packet header processing in reconfigurable hardware switches used in Software Defined Networking (SDN). The switch includes ingress and egress pipelines, each comprising a parser, a match-action unit (MAU), and a deparser. For each packet, the parser separates header data from the payload and determines which header fields may be processed by the MAU. It populates a primary packet header vector (PPHV) with participating fields and a secondary packet header vector (SPHV) with non-participating fields. The PPHV is delivered to the MAU, which contains match-action stages that match header fields against match tables and apply actions (e.g., assigning output ports, dropping packets, modifying fields). The SPHV bypasses the MAU and is delivered directly to the deparser, along with the payload. The deparser reassembles the packet from the processed PPHV data, the unprocessed SPHV data, and the payload, then sends it to a queuing system (ingress) or out of the switch (egress).

The parser determines which fields are participating based on information in the packet headers themselves (e.g., the EtherType field) and configuration data from the control plane. A compiler in the control plane generates configuration data, including a parse graph and control/table flow graphs, which a configurator module distributes to the parser and MAU. The parser uses an extractor state machine that follows the parse graph, iteratively extracting header fields into the PPHV or SPHV and determining how to extract subsequent headers.

This separation improves switch efficiency in several ways. It prevents wasting MAU resources on unused data—for example, only four bytes of a twenty-byte TCP header are often processed. It also enables the parser to parse deeper into packets, such as those using tunneling protocols like GENEVE or multi-layer tunneling, while sending the same amount of data to the MAU via the fixed-size PPHV. Each MAU stage includes a crossbar, exact match tables (SRAM), ternary match tables (TCAM), and a VLIW action engine.

The California Supreme Court granted a writ of mandate compelling the Superior Court of Los Angeles County to strike a "Report of Presiding Judge" from the records of McAdoo v. McAdoo, a divorce case filed and tried on July 17, 1934, before Judge Campbell, a visiting judge from Kern County, who granted an interlocutory decree. The report, based on the presiding judge's investigation, found that plaintiff's attorney Henry Grivi had circumvented the court's rules for setting default divorce cases by taking advantage of the visiting judge's unfamiliarity with local procedure, criticized his conduct, and announced new file-handling measures. After the defendant's motion to strike the report was denied, Grivi sought the writ. The court held that while mandamus constitutes a collateral attack and cannot correct errors of an inferior tribunal, the issue was whether the presiding judge had jurisdiction to file the report. Concluding that the report concerned the attorney's conduct rather than any issue in the divorce case, and that it resulted from an ex parte investigation conducted without notice to the attorney, the court found the judge lacked jurisdiction to place it in the divorce action's records and ordered the peremptory writ issued.

This MIT lecture completes the study of Poisson processes. After reviewing that a Poisson process is an arrival process with IID exponential interarrival times—viewable through interarrival times, arrival epochs, or the counting process N(t)—and that it has memoryless interarrivals and stationary, independent increments, the lecture presents alternate equivalent definitions based on these properties plus the Poisson PMF or small-increment conditions.

The main new results are: (1) Combining—the sum of two independent Poisson processes with rates λ1 and λ2 is a Poisson process with rate λ1 + λ2, shown via a small-increment argument; sums of many small independent arrival processes tend to be Poisson, a plausibility argument relevant to internet traffic. (2) Splitting—a Poisson process whose arrivals are independently routed with probability p by a Bernoulli process yields two independent Poisson processes with rates λp and λ(1−p); combining and splitting are typically used together. (3) An example of a last come, first served queue with an exponential server: modeling arrivals and service completions as a combined Poisson process of rate λ + μ, the probability an arrival completes service before interruption is μ/(λ + μ), and the probability of no further interruptions after one interruption is (μ/(λ + μ))². (4) Non-homogeneous Poisson processes, with time-varying rate λ(t), modeled for optical transmission; counting-process formulas still apply using the average rate over an interval, but interarrival times are no longer exponential.

Finally, conditioning on N(t) = n, the arrival epochs are uniformly distributed with joint density n!/tⁿ over 0 < s1 < ... < sn < t. This is explained via order statistics: n IID uniform random variables on (0, t), when ordered, have the same distribution as Poisson arrival epochs given N(t) = n; the n! factor arises from the symmetry of n! equal-volume permutation regions. For example, E[S1] = t/(n+1). The lecture closes with a paradox: an arbitrary time t falls in an interval whose mean length exceeds the mean interarrival time 1/λ, because random times are more likely to land in large intervals; a fuller explanation awaits renewal theory.

The document describes peripheral information and timings for the TMS320DM814x DaVinci Digital Media Processor (Texas Instruments, 2012–2014).

- **PLLs and clocks:** PLLs have minimum/maximum REFCLK, CLKDCO, and CLKOUT limits and operate in HS1 or HS2 modes selected via the SELFREQDCO field; PLL_USB must be programmed to 960 MHz when USB is used. SYSCLK and Module Clock maximum frequencies are listed, valid for OPP100 with higher limits for OPP120/OPP166.
- **Interrupts:** The ARM Cortex-A8 Interrupt Controller (AINTC) handles up to 128 requests with programmable priorities (FIQs unsupported on General-Purpose devices). The C674x DSP controller combines 128 events into 12 prioritized interrupts, with events 15–95 alternatively sourced from 24 multiplexed events.
- **Timing methodology:** AC timings use a specified test load, 3.3-V levels (Vref = 1.5 V), and 4 V/ns input slew; board routing delays are excluded and IBIS models are recommended (not required for DDR2).
- **Peripherals:** Two DCAN interfaces support CAN 2.0 A/B with FIFO, loop-back, and bus-off recovery. The EDMA supports 64 channels mapped to synchronization events and 512 parameter entries. Debug features include Advanced Event Triggering, Trace (ETB or 5-pin interface), and IEEE 1149.1 JTAG with JTAG ID register value 0x0B8F 202F at 0x4814 0600.
- **Ethernet:** The EMAC SW is a 3-port gigabit switch supporting 10/100/1000 Mbps via MII, GMII, RMII, and RGMII, with MDIO PHY control, CPPI buffer descriptor memory (2048 words/512 descriptors), extensive register listings, and timing for each interface mode.
- **Other peripherals:** GPIO provides four 32-channel modules (up to 128 pins) with interrupt generation; GPMC interfaces NOR/NAND/SRAM with BCH error detection via the ELM; HDMI 1.3a transmitter includes TMDS routing rules (100 Ω differential) and ESD protection requirements; HDVPSS provides two display pipelines and video capture/output up to 165 MHz; video DACs operate in Normal or TVOUT Bypass modes; four I2C modules support Philips spec 2.1 at 10–400 Kbps; the ISS includes parallel camera and CSI2 interfaces with an ISP.
- **DDR2/DDR3:** The memory controller supports 16/32-bit paths, two chip selects, and two PHYs. Detailed PCB design rules cover stackup (six-layer minimum for DDR2, four-layer for DDR3), device placement, keepout regions, bulk and high-speed bypass capacitors, termination, VREF routing, and clock/signal net class routing specifications for both DDR2 and DDR3 interfaces.

Fifth Third Bank has announced a $10.9 billion all-stock acquisition of Comerica, creating the ninth-largest U.S. lender with approximately $288 billion in combined assets. The deal, approved by both boards and pending regulatory clearance, will expand Fifth Third's presence in Florida, Arizona, and California while reinforcing its Midwest dominance. Comerica shareholders will receive just under 1.9 Fifth Third shares per share, valuing Comerica at roughly $82.88 per share—a 20% premium to its recent average price. Three Comerica board members will join Fifth Third's leadership after completion. Fifth Third's stock rose 1.4% on the news, lifting its market value above $29 billion. The merger, expected to close in early 2026, reflects growing regional bank consolidation, though critics warn it could heighten systemic risks. Comerica had faced activist investor pressure to consider a sale.

E-mini S&P 500 futures are financial derivatives introduced in 1997 that track the S&P 500 index of the 500 largest US stocks. At 1/5th the size of the standard 1982 contract, they are among the most frequently traded equity index futures on the CME Globex platform, used for speculation, hedging, arbitrage, and spread trading. A trading strategy for these futures involves technical and fundamental analysis for market timing, position sizing, and risk management. The authors describe a backtested mean reversion strategy (kept behind a paywall) using daily CME data, with no risk management parameters applied. Seasonality shows better performance in winter and spring than in summer. Contract specifications include: one unit equal to $50 times the index value; quarterly contracts (Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec); cash settlement based on special opening quotes on the third Friday of the contract month; a tick size of $12.50 on Globex; and a minimum price fluctuation of 0.25 index points. Trading runs Sunday to Friday, 6:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. ET, with a one-hour break. As of November 30, 2022, the contract traded at $4020.25; the all-time high was 4808.25 (January 2022) and the all-time low was 665.75 (March 2009). The biggest risk is adverse price movement amplified by leverage. Trading requires a futures broker, though some brokers offer CFDs on the contract.

The passage consists mainly of repeated headlines and promotional material for Pan Finance, along with one full article. The article reports that Poland will invest 20 billion zlotys ($5.5 billion) to connect its national fuel pipeline system with NATO's Central Europe Pipeline System, extending infrastructure by about 300 kilometres and adding new storage facilities. NATO has committed 60 million zlotys for planning and design, with construction expected to span several years. Once complete, the link will integrate Poland with pipelines running through Belgium, France, Germany, Luxembourg, and the Netherlands, enabling more flexible and secure fuel supply for NATO forces in times of crisis. Officials describe the project as a strategic step to strengthen resilience against supply disruptions and reinforce Poland's role as a frontline NATO state amid tensions following Russia's war in Ukraine. Risks include coordinating fuel allocation, operational standards, and regulatory compliance across multiple states, with delays potentially increasing costs.

The buy-and-hold strategy is a passive, long-term investing approach in which investors purchase stocks or ETFs and hold them for many years or decades, selling only portions when money is needed. It ignores short-term price fluctuations and contrasts with active trading, where traders attempt to time the market. The strategy aligns with the Efficient Market Hypothesis and is endorsed by investors like Warren Buffett. Studies indicate buy-and-hold investors tend to outperform active traders over longer horizons, partly due to tax benefits from deferring capital gains and lower trading costs. It can be implemented through growth or value investing, individual stock portfolios, or diversified funds; the easiest and least risky approach is buying index-tracking funds like the S&P 500. Benefits include cost savings, reduced manager risk, less stress, and time savings. Critics argue investors may not sell at optimal times, and most stocks deliver poor long-term returns, making stock selection difficult—though examples like Amazon and Apple illustrate potential gains. A backtest of SPY from 1993 produced a 9.7% annual return, while a portfolio of trading strategies showed smoother returns with fewer drawdowns. The article concludes that buy-and-hold and trading are fundamentally different approaches, and for most people, passive buy-and-hold investing is the best option for building wealth.

This cross-sectional study investigated the determinants of wasting, stunting, and undernutrition among children under five years of age in southern Punjab, Pakistan. Globally in 2019, 47.0 million children under five were wasted and 144.0 million were stunted, with South Asia having the highest numbers. According to Pakistan's National Nutrition Survey 2018, stunting prevalence was 40.2%, wasting 17.7%, and 28.9% of children under five were underweight.

A multicenter cross-sectional study was conducted at Community Management of Acute Malnutrition (CMAM) centers in four villages of southern Punjab. A total of 185 children aged 6–59 months with severe wasting (weight-for-height < -3 SD) or stunting (height-for-age < -2 SD) were enrolled. Information on sociodemographic characteristics, child nutrition, and healthcare was collected through parent interviews, and anthropometric measurements were taken by qualified nutritional supervisors. Data were analyzed using SPSS 25.0 with t-tests and linear regression.

Of the 185 participants (mean age 15.36 months), the majority were female (56.2%), had a family income of ≤15000 PKR (69.2%), and had at least two siblings (77.8%). Multivariate analysis showed wasting was significantly associated with family monthly income and complementary feeding practices; stunting was associated with tuberculosis contact history and exclusive breastfeeding practices; and undernutrition was associated with monthly income and exclusive breastfeeding practices.

The study concluded that wasting, stunting, and undernutrition were associated with exclusive breastfeeding and complementary feeding practices, household size, family earning, and history of infections. The authors noted the cross-sectional design as a limitation and stated that concerted efforts from all sectors of society are needed to address child malnutrition in Pakistan.

The speaker reflects on his history with goaltenders such as Glenn Hall, Jacques Plante, Ken Dryden, Bob Sauve, Donny Edwards, and Tom Barrasso, saying good goalies enjoy practicing and calling goaltending the most unique position in sports. The passage explains three core values of design patterns for distributed systems: learning from others' experience, providing a shared vocabulary that speeds communication, and enabling reusable components. It then describes single-node patterns—tightly coupled groups of containers co-scheduled on one machine (called pods in Kubernetes)—motivated by resource isolation, team ownership, and separation of concerns. The sidecar pattern adds a container that augments the application container, illustrated by adding HTTPS to a legacy service via an nginx proxy, synchronizing configuration through a shared directory, providing process monitoring (topz), and building a simple Git-based PaaS. Successful sidecars require parameterization (preferably via environment variables), stable APIs, and documentation using Dockerfile directives. The ambassador pattern brokers communication between an application and external services, demonstrated through client-side sharding (Redis with twemproxy), service brokering for environment portability, and request splitting for experiments. The adapter pattern standardizes an application's interface, applied to monitoring (Prometheus exporters), log normalization (Fluentd), and rich health checks (MySQL). The passage then introduces microservices, noting benefits such as small teams, decoupled releases, and independent scaling, alongside drawbacks of harder debugging and design. Multi-node patterns include replicated load-balanced services for stateless applications, which require readiness probes, session tracking (IP hashing internally, cookies externally, with consistent hashing to minimize disruption when scaling), caching layers (Varnish) for performance, rate limiting, and SSL termination (nginx). Finally, sharded services divide data across machines for stateful systems; sharded caches improve memory utilization over replicated caches, may themselves be replicated for reliability, and rely on sharding functions characterized by determinism and uniformity.

The Death Cross is a trading signal formed when a short-term moving average (typically the 50-day) crosses below a long-term moving average (typically the 200-day). It attracts significant media attention and speculation about potential bear markets. Backtests on the S&P 500 show the Death Cross signals short-term weakness, with returns below random for periods under 30 days, but longer-term returns align with market averages. Selling at a Death Cross and reentering at the opposite Golden Cross produced a 7% CAGR—slightly below buy-and-hold—but with 30% less time in the market and lower drawdowns. The indicator's main value is defensive, helping reduce drawdowns, though it can cause premature exits during bull markets, as illustrated by the March 2020 COVID-19 Death Cross that occurred near the market bottom.

Northern Oil & Gas refinanced its 8.125% unsecured notes due March 2028 with a $725 million private offering of new notes due October 2033, making its next note maturity the 3.625% convertible notes due April 2029. The author believes weak near-term oil prices improve the odds of $70+ oil in 2027.

Real estate veteran Amir Korangy argues that "not everyone should be an owner," despite millennials and Gen Z's strong desire for homeownership. With mortgage rates around 6% and home prices 55% higher than in early 2020, renting is often cheaper—saving over $900 per month on average and costing less than buying in 49 of the 50 largest U.S. metros. Korangy points to hidden ownership costs like insurance, taxes, and repairs, and notes equity building has weakened, with homeowners losing an average of $9,200 in equity over the past year. Renting also offers flexibility, allowing people to leave anytime without being tied to the market.

Players respect the opportunity, knowing they may not get another chance, and have performed well in similar environments in Montreal and Buffalo.
Plaintiffs, who prepared the contract, failed to prove they gave the required five-day written notice, so judgment was reversed and directed for defendant.

This patent application, a continuation of earlier filings, relates to systems, devices, and methods for delivering neural modulation. It describes implantable neurostimulation systems comprising an implantable pulse generator (IPG) and leads with electrodes that deliver neurostimulation energy to neural targets, programmed via external devices using stimulation parameters specifying spatial, temporal, and informational aspects of pulse patterns.

The disclosed subject matter concerns identifying optimal neuromodulation parameter sets. A processor accesses patient input (e.g., subjective data such as visual analog scale, numerical rating scale, satisfaction scores, or activity levels), clinician input (e.g., selected parameter sets, dimensions such as frequency, pulse width, or spatial location, or search configuration options such as test ranges, termination criteria, or survival thresholds), or automatic input (e.g., data from patient devices such as accelerometers, heart rate monitors, or IPGs providing activity data, heart rate, or field potentials). These inputs are used in a search method that evaluates candidate neuromodulation parameter sets to identify an optimal set, which is then used to program a neuromodulator.

Search methods described include a sorting algorithm that ranks candidate parameter sets by patient scores and discards those below a threshold; a gradient descent method that iteratively optimizes a parameter dimension; and a sensitivity analysis that builds a regression model relating stimulation variables to outcome variables to identify sensitive and insensitive parameters.

The background and detailed description cover spinal cord anatomy, conventional spinal cord stimulation (SCS) targeting dorsal column fibers per the gate control theory of pain, and sub-perception therapy delivered at various frequencies and duty cycles. System components include electrodes, a modulation device with output and control circuits, a programming device with a graphical user interface, and an SCS system comprising percutaneous leads, an IPG, a remote control, a programmer, an external trial stimulator, and a charger.

A machine learning system may operate in a closed loop, cycling through sub-perception modalities, collecting objective and subjective pain metrics (e.g., EEG, fMRI, heart rate variability, pain scores), estimating wash-in/wash-out times, and correlating feedback with efficacy to optimize stimulation patterns without intensive clinician involvement. A user feedback subsystem with a graphical interface allows patients to rate, sort, and skip programs; a "best so far" program may be reused, and patient blinding options exist. To avoid neurological conditioning, multiple programs may be cycled on regular or irregular schedules. Search spaces may be bounded in time and space domains, and noise in patient feedback may be managed through averaging, objective measures, or repeated evaluations.

This passage is from the SD Memory Card Physical Layer Simplified Specification Version 6.00. It describes the tuning command (CMD19), which must complete 40 executions within 150ms. In Data Transfer Mode, the host operates at fPP frequency, uses SEND_CSD (CMD9) to obtain card data, SET_DSR (CMD4) to configure driver stages, and CMD7 to select one card at a time into Transfer State. Read and write commands can be aborted with CMD12; write commands must be stopped before card deselection. The card provides write buffering, holding DAT0 low when busy. Wide bus (4-bit) mode is selected via ACMD6, with 1-bit as the default. For 2GB cards, the maximum block length is 1024 bytes, though CMD16 sets blocks up to 512 bytes.

Block reads (CMD17 single, CMD18 multiple) use a maximum 512-byte block size with CRC protection. Block writes require CRC checks; WRITE_BL_PARTIAL enables smaller blocks. ACMD23 pre-erases blocks to speed multiple block writes. Erase operations use CMD32/CMD33/CMD38 sequences, with Discard (argument 00000001h, 250ms busy timeout) and FULE (argument 00000002h, 1 second busy timeout) variants supported only by SDHC/SDXC cards and not through SPI.

Three write protection methods exist: a mechanical switch, internal protection, and password lock via CMD42 using 128-bit PWD and 8-bit PWD_LEN registers. Card Ownership Protection (COP) adds FEP registers and requires CMD42[1Fh] (COP Unlock) after power-up when FEP is set. Locked cards accept only basic commands, ACMD41, CMD16, and lock commands; ACMD6 is rejected while locked.

APP_CMD (CMD55) causes the following command to be interpreted as an application-specific command. The switch function command (CMD6) supports function groups for access mode, command system, driver strength, and power limit, operating in check (mode 0) and set (mode 1) modes with a 512-bit status response. High-Speed mode (25 MB/sec at 50 MHz) is enabled via CMD6. CMD8 verifies host supply voltage and returns R7. SDHC/SDXC cards use block addressing with fixed 512-byte blocks, while SDSC uses byte addressing. The host may lower or stop the bus clock, providing 8 clocks after transactions. CRC7 protects commands and responses; CRC16 protects data blocks. Read timeouts are 100ms; write busy is typically 250ms, extendable to 500ms for SDXC in specified cases.

The Apple Watch Series 10 in 42mm rose gold with GPS and cellular is at its lowest price yet following the Series 11 announcement. It features a larger, brighter display, slimmer and lighter design, new water features like a temperature sensor and tides app, and fast charging in about 20 minutes. Battery life matches the Series 9. The Series 11 offers better battery and a blood oxygen sensor, but the Series 10 saves money for cellular users and works only with iPhones.
The speaker is frustrated by a league decision following an unintentional hit to an opponent's mouth during a game, which prevents them from competing, though they still want their team to win.

Southwest Airlines' planes make more short flights per day than other U.S. carriers, adding wear on parts including engines. After a deadly engine failure on Flight 1380—in which a fan blade showing metal fatigue snapped off and passenger Jennifer Riordan was killed—questions arose about whether the airline's low-cost model puts passengers at risk. Until then, no passenger had died in an accident in Southwest's 47-year history, though a 2005 runway accident killed a boy in a car. The airline has paid millions in fines for safety violations, including a $7.5 million FAA fine in 2009 and a $2.8 million settlement over improper fuselage repairs. Its mechanics' union accused the company of pressuring workers to cut corners, and the FAA found mistrust of management that could hurt safety. Safety experts nonetheless say Southwest is not unsafe, citing its large fleet and strong record. Southwest says it has inspected fan blades per engine-maker recommendations and will inspect older blades by the end of August. CEO Gary Kelly pledged support to Riordan's family, and the airline offered Flight 1380 passengers $5,000 and a $1,000 travel voucher.

As part of its "Of America" series, The Washington Post sent reporters across the country to ask Americans what patriotism means at a time when Trump calls his supporters "American patriots" and casts critics as "un-American."

In Fargo, N.D., Jane Pettinger, a 57-year-old college professor and Air Force veteran critical of Trump's Vietnam-era draft deferments, views protest as patriotic and wants to restore a progressive America. Dave Richardson, a 69-year-old retired Navy veteran waiting in line for Trump's rally, defines patriotism as honoring military service, the Pledge of Allegiance and the anthem, and supports Trump's criticism of NFL players who kneel.

This passage is from a Texas Instruments datasheet (ADS9801/ADS9803) covering daisy-chain SPI configuration, register descriptions, and application information. Daisy-chain mode is enabled on power-up or after device reset by setting the DAISY_CHAIN_LEN register, which specifies the number of ADCs in the chain excluding ADC1. Register writes in daisy-chain require N × 24 SCLKs per SPI frame. Register reads involve selecting a register bank via REG_BANK_SEL, enabling reads with SPI_RD_EN, then sending N-times {0xFE, 0x00, address} frames followed by N-times {0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF} frames to read out data.

The document describes numerous registers, including configuration interface settings, daisy-chain length, register bank selection, data format, data averaging, XOR/PRBS operations, digital test patterns for channels 1–8, user-defined appended bits, speed-boost mode, simple averaging configuration, 21-bit gain error correction codes for ADCs A and B, analog input bandwidth and power-down control, internal/external reference selection, output data lane modes (4-lane and 2-lane), and common-mode range configuration.

Application information describes the ADS9803 as an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data acquisition system for ATE applications, with a post-calibration TUE of 0.0015% at 25°C ±5°C. It offers low-noise (up to 22.7kHz) and wide-bandwidth (up to 700kHz) modes, uses three power supplies (AVDD_5V, VDD_1V8, IOVDD) with no required power-up sequence, and includes board layout recommendations for bypass capacitors and signal routing.

The document concludes with support resources, trademark notices, ESD handling caution, revision history, mechanical/packaging information, and standard legal disclaimers.

В статье рассматривается применение радиочастотной идентификации (RFID) в розничной торговле. Отмечается, что после трудностей внедрения в 2000-х годах (высокая стоимость меток, незрелость стандартов, проблемы интеграции в IT-ландшафты) цифровая трансформация создала предпосылки для возрождения технологии. RFID обеспечивает точную инвентаризацию (~98%) в реальном времени, борьбу с потерями и кражами, умные примерочные и автоматизацию складской логистики. Описывается архитектура RFID-системы: метки с электронным кодом продукта (EPC), считыватели, корпоративная подсистема (серверы, middleware, базы данных) и организационная подсистема (EPCIS). Обзор исследований показывает применение RFID для трекинга поведения покупателей, управления запасами и цепочками поставок. Эффективность внедрения оценивается через систему сбалансированных показателей: ROI 20–30% за два года, снижение потерь от краж до 75%, сокращение затрат на логистику и инвентаризацию на 30%, рост продаж на 5–10%, сокращение времени кассовых операций на 50%, точность онлайн-заказов до 98%. Предложена архитектура сбора и обработки данных на основе ETL-процессов (с использованием SSIS), промежуточной и основной баз данных и многомерного куба данных. Разработана логическая модель, объединяющая транзакционные POS-данные с трекинговыми RFID-данными (координаты, скорость, время перемещений) через ID клиента для анализа пути клиента. Делается вывод, что RFID переводит ритейл в область решений на основе данных; дальнейшее развитие связано с интеграцией технологии с IoT и искусственным интеллектом.
